pipeline.title: Rezolute gets an uplift from phase 3 tumor hyperinsulinism win ahead of FDA meeting
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 clinical trial of Rezolute’s ersodetug in tumor hyperinsulinism has hit its primary endpoint, boosting the biotech ahead of a potential filing for FDA approval in another indication.

pipeline.title: Regeneron posts positive phase 2 data for baloncibart in nervous system disorder, eyes pivotal trial
pipeline.summary: Regeneron has posted positive phase 2 data on baloncibart in postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, teeing the biotech up to start a potentially pivotal trial in the first half of 2027.

pipeline.title: Blackstone bets $1.5B on Pfizer’s obesity drug
pipeline.summary: The deal will support a sprawling Phase 3 program for a monthly GLP-1 shot Pfizer acquired by winning a bidding war for the drug’s previous owner, Metsera.

pipeline.title: Kyverna abandons next-gen autoimmune CAR-T once touted as follow-up to miv-cel
pipeline.summary: Kyverna is halting work on a next-gen CD19 CAR-T therapy as the biotech seeks FDA approval for what could become the first CAR-T treatment for an autoimmune disease.

pipeline.title: Addex spinout Neurosterix raises $105M series B to fund phase 2 schizophrenia trial
pipeline.summary: Addex Therapeutics’ neuropsychiatric-focused spinout has raised $105 million in series B funds to bankroll a planned phase 2 study of its schizophrenia treatment.

pipeline.title: BioNTech pays $205M for FDA voucher to speed up ‘late-stage oncology pipeline’
pipeline.summary: BioNTech has agreed to pay $205 million to purchase an FDA priority review voucher to support a future filing of a drug in its “late-stage oncology pipeline.” Fierce breaks down which candidate is most likely to claim the regulatory accelerator.

pipeline.title: Amgen builds Sjögren’s case with detailed phase 3 data ahead of Novartis showdown
pipeline.summary: Amgen has shared more data from a phase 3 Sjögren’s disease trial that dazzled analysts, digging into the details that could shape its showdown with Novartis.

pipeline.title: Merck KGaA lands FDA nod in rare tumor disorder, portending Ono, Daiichi showdown
pipeline.summary: The FDA’s decision was based on Merck’s phase 3 Maneuver trial and follows similar approvals by other global regulators, including in China, Canada and Switzerland.

pipeline.title: ImmunityBio juggles phase 3 win and 20% stock crash en route to Anktiva front-line expansion
pipeline.summary: ImmunityBio's Anktiva secured a pivotal phase 3 win in front-line non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, but lack of detailed data and disappointing third-quarter financials sent the biotech's stock tumbling by 20%.

pipeline.title: Rivia launches AI-powered clinical trial data review module, with Scancell as early adopter
pipeline.summary: Swiss data engine Rivia has launched a new AI-powered data review module to speed up clinical data cleaning.

pipeline.title: AZ keeps pressure on Keytruda with Imfinzi expansion in chemo-ineligible bladder cancer
pipeline.summary: Looking to challenge a preeminent Keytruda cocktail in cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC), AstraZeneca has crossed the finish line with its own doublet wedding Pfizer and Astellas’ Padcev with its PD-L1 inhibitor Imfinzi.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca cuts 600 US sales jobs amid $1.5B savings plan: Bloomberg
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca’s $1.5 billion cost-savings drive has started to take a toll on its U.S. workforce. The British pharma has cut about 600 jobs from its respiratory and immunology commercial teams in the U.S., Bloomberg reports.

pipeline.title: Europe's CHMP backs Baxfendy, gives Hansoh's Aumseqa another chance
pipeline.summary: Amid a slate of regulatory decisions this week, the CHMP backed AstraZeneca's Baxfendy and endorsed Hansoh's application for Aumseqa after revoking its original marketing authorization earlier this summer.

pipeline.title: Teva CEO 'proud' of pipeline buzz as innovative-generics hybrid rolls out 1st R&D day
pipeline.summary: While acknowledging that Teva’s peak sales estimate for its tranche of late-stage pipeline darlings may be verging on “aspirational,” at least one analyst team walked away from the company’s first R&D investor confab this week feeling “increasingly confident” in the firm’s di

pipeline.title: Bavarian Nordic C-suite stability in question as CFO steps down amid Q3 beat
pipeline.summary: As Bavarian Nordic’s new CEO Tarja Stenvall makes her debut, CFO Henrik Juuel is stepping down.

pipeline.title: The promise of molecular gates and what comes next
pipeline.summary: Gate Bioscience is developing a new class of medicines designed to eliminate disease-causing proteins at their source. In this episode of "The Top Line," Gate co-founder and CEO Jordi Mata-Fink, Ph.D., discusses the promise of molecular gates, the biotech's expanded partnership w

pipeline.title: Charles River pays $470M for 2 Frontage bioanalysis labs in Pennsylvania
pipeline.summary: Charles River Laboratories has acquired Tigermed’s Frontage laboratory sites for $470 million upfront to advance its bioanalysis footprint.

pipeline.title: Novo submits sickle cell drug; Flagship, Gates Foundation deepen ties
pipeline.summary: Novo views the medicine, acquired in a billion-dollar deal, as a future blockbuster. Meanwhile, a pair of startups forged an RNA editing pact and Astellas lined up two new trials in pancreatic cancer.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: Brain drugs are back on venture capitalists’ minds
pipeline.summary: Five neurology-focused startups have together raised around $450 million in the last few weeks. Elsewhere, investors had a muted response to the latest cell therapy research.

pipeline.title: American Cancer Society updates prostate cancer screening guidance
pipeline.summary: For the first time in 16 years, the American Cancer Society (ACS) has updated its guideline for prostate cancer screening as it drives to boost detection of the disease before it spreads.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—China’s Big Pharma ambition; Treasury’s China crackdown; Takeda’s narcolepsy launch
pipeline.summary: Chinese companies have a Big Pharma dream. Experts told Fierce that the U.S. Treasury's draft policy on banning certain U.S. investments in China is too ambiguous and could backfire. Takeda's novel orexin drug has won a favorable DEA designation. And more.

pipeline.title: Novo amps up Wegovy marketing with DJ Khaled spinning his weight-loss tale
pipeline.summary: Novo and DJ Khaled have teamed up to share how the DJ, rapper and record producer has incorporated the GLP-1 drug Wegovy into his weight-loss routine.

pipeline.title: Sanofi teams with British comic Beano for Type 1 diabetes education push

pipeline.summary: The Swiss biotech, which pocketed another $50 million through a concurrent private share sale to Sanofi, is developing a potential competitor to the blockbuster asthma treatment Tezspire.

pipeline.title: ARPA-H bets $4.9 million on ibogaine for PTSD treatment in veterans
pipeline.summary: The U.S. department of health and human services announced a $4.9 million bet to advance the development of ibogaine for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).

pipeline.title: Pharmas should stay agile as Democrats amp up scrutiny over Trump's MFN deals
pipeline.summary: Industry experts are calling for pharma leaders to ready for heavier oversight as a newly blue Congress demands an unredacted look at President Trump's controversial MFN drug pricing deals.
